what: Blocking scope rule FINAL: use minimum scope depth, not distance from file. Scopes need ≥2 path segments to trigger blocking. src/** (depth 1) = too broad = soft. src/api/** (depth 2) = specific enough = block. Exact file scopes always block. MIN_SCOPE_DEPTH=2 in recall-for-path.js, configurable later. This excludes root-level and src-level scopes from blocking while allowing feature-area scopes to block.
why: User clarified: blocking should be based on scope specificity, not distance from file. src/** covers the whole source tree — not useful for blocking. Minimum depth approach is simpler and directly maps to "is this scope specific enough."
